queue.title: Reports
queue.openForTarget: {count, plural, one {# open report on this player} other {# open reports on this player}}

evidence.incomplete: Part of the evidence could not be read: what follows is incomplete.

roomStatus.lobby: The room was waiting for a game to start.

evidence.transcriptLead: The latest messages when the report was made, oldest first. The reported player's lines are marked.
evidence.gameLogLead: What a spectator saw: no hidden information.

actions.title: Actions
actions.protected: You cannot ban or rename this account: it is yours, or a member of the moderation team.
actions.targetDeleted: The reported account was deleted: you can still dismiss the report or add a note.
actions.closed: This report is closed. You can still act on the account.

ban.title: Ban the player
ban.reasonHint: The player reads this reason on their profile, with the end date and the contact address. 500 characters at most.

rename.title: Force a rename
rename.lead: The account gets a neutral name ("Player 12345") and may choose another one at once.

byName.title: Ban by display name
byName.lead: For a report received by e-mail: the player's exact display name (case and accents ignored).
byName.name: Player's display name

notices.banLive: {count, plural, =0 {The player was in no open room.} one {They were removed from one open room.} other {They were removed from # open rooms.}}
notices.banUnreachable: The rooms server did not answer: the ban is recorded and the player cannot enter a room any more, but their current connections were not closed.
notices.renameLive: {count, plural, =0 {The player was in no open room.} one {The new name shows in one open room.} other {The new name shows in # open rooms.}}
notices.renameUnreachable: The rooms server did not answer: the new name will show the next time they enter a room.

errors.signInRequired: Your session expired: sign in again.
errors.reasonRequired: Give a reason: the player will read it.
errors.reasonTooLong: The reason is longer than 500 characters.
errors.noteTooLong: The note is longer than 1,000 characters.
errors.playerNotFound: No player has this display name.
errors.reportNotFound: This report does not exist or is not about this player.
errors.banNotActive: This ban was already lifted or is over.
errors.self: You cannot act on your own account.
errors.protectedTarget: This account belongs to the moderation team: only an administrator can act on a moderator, and nobody on an administrator.
errors.noFreeName: No free name found: try again.
